About the Scholarship

UBC's Four Year Doctoral Fellowship supports selected students admitted to eligible doctoral programmes. Funding decisions involve programme nomination, so applicants need to follow their department's admission process rather than look for a single university-wide application deadline.

Research Areas

  • Eligible UBC doctoral subjects
  • Doctoral study
  • Research training

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryCAD 24,000/year plus tuition (from September 2026)

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityWorldwide, subject to programme rules
Further conditionsDomestic and international students; selection through eligible doctoral programmes.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusAdmission-linked nomination
Deadline / consideration roundDoctoral programme-specific admission deadline
LocationCanada

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.grad.ubc.ca/awards/four-year-doctoral-fellowship-4yf

Source: grad.ubc.ca - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Doctoral programme-specific admission - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

  1. Review the scholarship conditions alongside the doctoral programme’s admission requirements.
  2. Complete the admission, scholarship or nomination steps specified by the host; do not assume one submission covers every stage.
  3. Submit by the deadline for your applicant category, or follow the stated consideration round where applications are rolling.

About University of British Columbia

UBC offers doctoral programmes through its graduate faculties. The Four Year Doctoral Fellowship supports selected doctoral students, with departments involved in admission and award nomination.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions
